tip: FIX — Your diagnostic work was excellent—rust, wiring errors, high pressures, oil leaks, aged refrigerant all documented. But after showing all that damage, ask: 'Here's what I'd recommend: Option A—try a repair on the upstairs; Option B—replace the upstairs unit; or Option C—let our specialist put together a plan for both units.' That question after diagnosis moves the customer from understanding the problem to committing to fix it.
